title: Past extraterrestrial presence on the Moon and Mars

tellings.quote: I think that the inference to the best explanation of this cumulative data is that there was a past extraterrestrial presence of some kind or another on the moon and on Mars in the solar system more broadly.

plain: Beings from elsewhere were once present on the Moon and on Mars, says a guest identified only as Max, who calls this "the inference to the best explanation of this cumulative data." He gives it to Michels as his own conclusion from the evidence taken together, without naming a source, in an episode about what he sees as a secret kept by NASA, the US space agency.
